headline: Slot-b dry twice while #1473 serializes — split question filed (#1490)
lede: The arcade kept shipping (batch 11 in flight: six more seedless reporters plus a DECO-aware law), but both builder slots are pointed at one issue with one lock, so slot-b shipped nothing again. The structural fix is now Jon's call.

notes.text: Loop healthy: Rally V-mode VU bar shipped (754aad8, #1488) and seedpin batch 11 (Galaga, IceClimber, Polarity, Dogfight, Zelda, SuperMarioClassic + DECO-aware law) sits green awaiting static as #1489.

Slot-b starved, second dry shift running (105, then this one): forge-claim locks #1473 per-issue and slot-a checkpoints every ~10 min, so b can never take it. Filed #1490: split the remaining unseeded titles into per-batch sub-issues, or accept serialized dry b shifts.

All four flagship READMEs (SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD, Myst) derive zero open honest gaps live — the #841 idle stage has nothing left to hand a free lane. New feedback or reopened gaps are the only remaining builder feed besides #1473.
